threshold: R >= 128, bounding rectangle uses exclusive right/bottom pixel edges

mapping.policy: contain-width-bottom; preserve complete source; no nonuniform stretch or per-city registration

psd.interpretation: Document ppi setting, not a measured physical production template

surface.interpretation: Photo-estimated default model; width is arc length at main cylinder radius; height is vertical UV extent, not curved meridian length

areaMethod: 4K pixel-centre sampling of G + label*(1-G), weighted by actual indexed triangle UV Jacobians; normalized to exact mesh area; not a physical measurement
